items.html: And the matter is that its ChGT become for it Chokhma, Bina, and Daat, and its NHY become for it ChGT. And this is through the drawing of the abundance of Aba and Ima, and it is the secret of the spreading of the two crowns (Atarim) with which it is crowned, etc.; and this is in "the crown with which his mother crowned him," which is his head. And now there remained missing for it NHY; then Bina had to extend her legs downward, and the secret of the illumination of the Yesod within her, for she too is the world of the male; and then NHY were made for it. For this is what is stated in the Zohar: "and from Bina, prophets.
